english.title: Fire an air weapon beyond premises
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) had with you at premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..), an air weapon, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AIR WEAPON..), which you used for firing

(A)_[a missile]_
(B)_[missiles]_

beyond those premises
english.legislation: Contrary to section 21A of and Schedule 6 to the Firearms Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
had with you at premises an air weapon
which you used for firing a missile/missiles

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence was inserted into the Firearms Act 1968 by section 34 of the Violent Crime Reduction Act 2006.
(ii) In proceedings against a person for this offence it shall be a defence for him to show that the only premises into or across which the missile was fired were premises the occupier of which had consented to the firing of the missile (whether specifically or by way of a general consent.
